# iSunTV 阳光卫视 · iSun1

> iSun1.com is the independent multilingual media edition of iSunTV, a Hong Kong satellite television channel. It presents documentary heritage, interviews, international brand collaboration and brand licensing information.

## Primary pages
- [About](https://isun1.com/about)
- [Going global](https://isun1.com/global)

- [Programme catalogue](https://isun1.com/programmes)
- [Chairman Chen Ping](https://isun1.com/chairman)
- [Robin Xie 谢玢](https://isun1.com/robin)
- [Brand licensing](https://isun1.com/licensing)
- [Authorization verification](https://isun1.com/verify)
- [Contact](https://isun1.com/contact)

## Identity and source boundaries
Robin Xie, Bin Xie, Bin "Robin" Xie, 谢玢 and 謝玢 identify the same person: Executive Director of iSunTV and Managing Partner of TideiSun Group. Her persistent Person identifier is https://www.tideisun.com/robin#robin-xie.

The default language is Simplified Chinese. Language editions: /zh-Hant, /en, /fr, /es, /ja, /hi and /he. Original programme titles and source playlist links are preserved. Summaries are source-based drafts; unknown details must not be inferred. Some summary translations remain in preparation and those video pages are excluded from indexing.

The authorization register is not published and contains no public license records. A brand profile, image or verification form is not proof of authorization. Seek confirmation through the contact page.

Legacy iSunOne financial-business content is retired and is not part of this media site.
